name: SDCodex Plugin Hub
description: Official SDCodex community plugins. Adding a plugin here makes it installable through SDCodex Settings -> Plugins.

core.name: SDCodex Core
core.description: The core SDCodex application. Increment this version every time core code is pushed so installs can notify about updates.

plugins.name: SDCodex Gallery
plugins.description: Disk-backed media gallery and workflow inspector.

plugins.name: GalleryDL & Tools
plugins.description: Background gallery-dl and yt-dlp task management, quick downloads, kiosks, OAuth configuration, and a persistent activity log.

plugins.name: RemBG Background Tools
plugins.description: High-precision background removal, replacement, and batch processing powered by BiRefNet & RemBG.

plugins.name: ComfyUI Captioning
plugins.description: Auto-captioning with LLMs/JoyCaption and ComfyUI custom workflow nodes. Download GGUF captioning models (Qwen3-VL-8B) from the Caption Models settings page.
